def _create_batch_message(self):
        """Create a ~uamqp.message.Message for a value supplied by the data
        generator. Applies all properties and annotations to the message.

        :rtype: ~uamqp.message.Message
        """
        message = Message()
        message.body = self._data_gen.next()
        if self._data_gen.annotations:
            message.application_properties = self._data_gen.annotations
        message.properties = self._data_gen.properties
        message.annotations = self._data_gen.annotations
        return message
